The root cause of the bug was the use of large constant values in the code that were not explicitly marked with the appropriate suffixes to indicate their data types. Specifically, constants like `4294967295` and `0x0000ffffffff0000` were treated as `int` by default, which can lead to warnings or errors when they exceed the range of the `int` type.
